name: key
title: A printed key with a tactile click: a stem on a two-leaf guide, a bump riding past a bump on a leaf
orientation: On its side, as drawn: one piece, no supports. Press the pad: the stem goes down on its guide, its bump pushes the click leaf aside and drops past it (the click), and it bottoms out on the frame.

body.label: The key: frame, guide, stem and click leaf in one print

height.rule: How tall it prints: the flexures' width, so it sets their force (a thinner print, a lighter key)

gap.rule: The least gap that prints apart

travel.rule: How far the stem goes down before it bottoms out: shorter than an MX switch's 4 mm, so the guide stays within its strain

press.rule: How far a press drives it: to just short of bottoming out

guide_len.rule: The guide's leaves: long, so the key is light

guide_t.rule: The guide leaves' thickness at their ends: the thinnest wall

taper.rule: How far the guide leaves taper towards their middles (0 a bar, 1 uniform strength)

least.rule: The thinnest a tapered leaf gets

round.rule: Rounds where flexures meet blocks, and on every inside corner

block.rule: The guide's base and shuttle blocks

stem_up.rule: How far the stem reaches up from the guide, to the pad

stem_down.rule: How far the stem reaches down from the guide

bump.rule: Each bump's height: the stem's and the click leaf's

engage.rule: How far the bumps overlap: how far the click leaf is pushed aside

click_at.rule: How far down the stem the bumps meet, apex to apex: where it clicks

into.rule: How far a leaf runs into the block it grows from

room.rule: Room beside the click leaf to bend away into, the far wall its stop: its round, how far it's pushed, and a little

peak_least.rule: The least a press should peak at

click.rule: How much the force should drop after the peak: the click you feel

spacer.rule: How far the click bump stands off its leaf, so the leaf's rounds keep clear of the stem
